scope: Historical development only. Six FIT scenes, INNER0002, exposed diagnostic0001. No fresh FIT16/INNER8/confirmation8 or VAL/TEST selection.
proxy_warning: Proxy is not actual HOTA/AssA. Separate real intervention-window and full-policy TrackEval are mandatory.
inputs: Frozen32 action-specific current/past joint-state features. Causal temporal uses previous3 actual-source proposal feature vectors and current action vector, zero padded. FIT-only mean/std, no truth fields or future observations.
labels: Complete windows only; strictly verified initial clicked UID only. Benefit/risk/neutral class and clipped expected raw trajectory value. Incomplete or invalid initialization remains reported, not replaced.
model_selection: Within each preregistered fit, earliest lowest INNER objective epoch. Retain every epoch/checkpoint/seed/family/state contrast. No choosing outer0001 effects or silent best-seed selection.
authority_actions: Same GT-free raw-anchor top2 and ACIB top1 real UID alternatives plus REJECT as corpus, hard infeasibility rejected by unchanged exact solver. Default KEEP. Never GT-best runtime action.
learned_authority_bounds: No blanket displacement/regret cap that already excludes every rescue. Include actual cost, competitor continuity and all displacement as learned risk inputs; sole authorization is calibrated predicted benefit/risk/value with exact hard constraints. Keep static P0 identity-memory no-write for this association-only diagnostic.
INNER_selection: 18 operating points per fit, choose highest count of beneficial event decisions subject to observed harmful selected decisions<=2%, at least5 accepted events; ties lower harm, fewer accepts, stricter benefit/harm/value. All points retained. If none qualifies, explicit CALIBRATION_ABSTAIN with zero accepted, not success. This one-scene calibration does not establish a population 2% guarantee.
event_decision: Highest predicted positive value among eligible non-KEEP actions, stable candidate UID/action ties. Retain coverage, actual benefit/harm and N01/N10; no-op cannot PASS.
on_policy: These are actual joint-state offline fits, not proof of closed-loop success or new-policy on-policy learning. Freeze checkpoints before new causal rollout; at most2 actual rollout/relabel rounds under separate versioned protocols.
